name: verify_productTag_audit_columns_by_id
note: product_tag: create/write uid and date per row (mail/chatter and the record's metadata read), keyed by id
source_sql: SELECT id, create_uid, write_uid, create_date, write_date FROM product_tag ORDER BY id

name: verify_productTag_scalar_listing
note: product_tag: every int/string/bool column of every row as a list view reads it, keyed by id
source_sql: SELECT id, sequence, color, visible_to_customers FROM product_tag ORDER BY id

name: verify_productTag_embed_fanout_by_parent
note: product_tag: per-parent count of each embedded array (product_tag_product_product_rel, product_tag_product_template_rel) against the child-row count, keyed by id
source_sql: SELECT r.id, COALESCE(e0.n, 0) AS n_productproductrel, COALESCE(e1.n, 0) AS n_producttemplaterel FROM product_tag r LEFT JOIN (SELECT product_tag_id AS pid, COUNT(*) AS n FROM product_tag_product_product_rel GROUP BY product_tag_id) e0 ON e0.pid = r.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT product_tag_id AS pid, COUNT(*) AS n FROM product_tag_product_template_rel GROUP BY product_tag_id) e1 ON e1.pid = r.id ORDER BY r.id
